applied_supersessions.new: The previous version may remain current until replacement approval only while it independently satisfies validity, authorization, review and all retrieval-eligibility restrictions.

applied_supersessions.new: Unapproved, failed, rejected, superseded or expired content must never support AI answers or knowledge citations. applied_supersessions.old: May not access knowledge belonging to other tenants unless separately authorized.
applied_supersessions.new: May not access knowledge belonging to other tenants in the first release.

applied_supersessions.old: Must not have routine access to tenant knowledge content.
applied_supersessions.new: Must not access tenant knowledge content in the first release.

applied_supersessions.old: Cross-tenant content access is prohibited by default and requires a separately authorized, time-limited, reasoned, and audited exception.
applied_supersessions.new: No exceptional Platform Admin tenant-content access is permitted in the first release, including break-glass, emergency, support or administrative overrides. A future capability requires separately governed requirements and authorization.

applied_supersessions.old: Existing approved versions remain available until their replacements are successfully approved.
applied_supersessions.new: Existing approved versions remain available only while otherwise eligible until replacements are successfully approved.

applied_supersessions.old: Only explicitly established and approved precedence rules may resolve a conflict automatically.
applied_supersessions.new: Explicitly approved authority/applicability rules may select only among otherwise eligible sources. They must not automatically resolve, close or reinstate flagged/excluded content; unresolved material conflict requires abstention and independent human review.

applied_supersessions.old: Reapproval or an explicitly authorized validity extension must be completed before the document becomes AI eligible again.
applied_supersessions.new: Reapproval or an explicitly authorized validity extension must follow eligible non-submitter approval and formal re-review, without bypassing the 180-day policy or any current eligibility restriction. A date change alone cannot restore AI eligibility.

applied_supersessions.old: Legally retained content must remain excluded from AI retrieval unless separately and legitimately authorized.
applied_supersessions.new: Deletion-approved content must remain excluded from AI retrieval, including after hold release. Any permitted use of other legally retained content outside approved deletion must independently satisfy every Q2/Q3 eligibility and authorization control.

applied_supersessions.old: Restricted tenant content and lifecycle-ineligible knowledge must never be used to populate response evidence.
applied_supersessions.new: Unauthorized content and lifecycle-ineligible knowledge must never support authoritative answers, knowledge citations or knowledge-based routing. Q6's narrow authorized draft/pending ingestion-classification rationale/review-evidence permission is preserved by Q8-C01; it does not grant content approval or answer/retrieval eligibility.

applied_supersessions.old: Internal notes may be included only when synthetic, explicitly authorized and necessary for the intended purpose.
applied_supersessions.new: All internal notes, including synthetic notes, are excluded from model context and transmission to the AI model. The earlier conditional permission is superseded; no internal-note exception is granted.
